nodes.label: Five Layer Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Separately compiled layers enforce downward dependencies because higher-layer types do not yet exist.

nodes.label: Managed
nodes.rationale: Use Managed for script-only classes so weak observers are nulled instead of becoming dangling pointers.

nodes.label: Lantern
nodes.rationale: Fictional teaching framework with original examples; it is not a published mod.

nodes.label: Reference Cycles
nodes.rationale: Owner-to-child references are strong; child-to-owner references are weak so ARC can release both.

nodes.label: Init Pattern
nodes.rationale: One parameterless constructor per class plus explicit Init methods avoids incompatible constructor signatures.

nodes.label: Modded Classes (The Key to DayZ Modding)
Guard Clauses
nodes.rationale: Without try/catch, validate each precondition before operations that could fail.

nodes.label: vector.DistanceSq
nodes.rationale: Squared distance comparisons avoid expensive square roots in frequent proximity checks.
